verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is an open-source static site generator. A product of this type could plausibly ship an AI-training opt-out, such as a vendor data-use policy or built-in controls to block AI crawlers from scraping site content, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or AI-crawler controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
